notes.text: Euclid was an ancient Greek mathematician active as a geometer and logician.

Euclid's system, now referred to as Euclidean geometry, involved innovations in combination with a synthesis of theories from earlier Greek mathematicians, including Eudoxus of Cnidus, Hippocrates of Chios, Thales and Theaetetus.
Euclid is remembered as a mathematician connected with Egypt.
Euclid's recorded life dates place this profile around -350--240.
Euclid is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
